blocks.html: Akaar L1 is a robust large-format 3D printer engineered for professionals, labs, and industrial workshops, built to reliably produce large, high-strength parts using engineering-grade materials, making it ideal for functional prototypes, tooling, jigs, and end-use components.

• A rigid, industrial-grade frame designed for stability and reliability, ensuring consistent print quality even during high-speed, long-duration prints.
  • Print large, complex parts rapidly with a motion system capable of speeds up to 500 mm/s, significantly reducing production time without compromising accuracy.
  • A spacious 600 × 500 × 600 mm build area enables printing of large single-piece components or multiple parts in one job, ideal for industrial and engineering applications.
  • An intelligent auto-leveling system precisely calibrates the build surface before every print, ensuring perfect first-layer adhesion and repeatable results with minimal setup effort.
  • HIWIN linear guideways deliver smooth, accurate motion and exceptional positional stability, ensuring high precision and consistent print quality across the full build volume.
  • A fully enclosed, temperature-controlled build chamber up to 70°C ensures dimensional stability and reliable printing of engineering-grade materials by minimizing warping and internal stress.
  • High-Temperature Nozzle - an all-metal, high-temperature nozzle capable of reaching 450°C enables reliable printing of advanced engineering and high-performance materials.
  • Built-in Monitoring Camera allows real-time remote monitoring of prints, helping users track progress, detect issues early, and improve overall print reliability.
  • Intuitive Touchscreen Interface, full-color touchscreen provides simple, intuitive control over printer operations, settings, and job monitoring for a smooth user experience.
  • Connectivity Support for USB, Wi-Fi, and Ethernet enables seamless file transfer and networked printing, making the printer easy to integrate into classrooms, labs, and production environments.
  • A durable, double-sided flexible PEI surface ensures excellent first-layer adhesion and effortless part removal across a wide range of materials.
  • A built-in filament drying system up to 70°C keeps materials dry during printing, improving layer adhesion, surface quality, and reliability with moisture-sensitive filaments.
  • An integrated HEPA filtration system captures fine particles and emissions during printing, improving air quality and making the printer safer for classrooms and workspaces.
